body:
Machine A: independent source review results, round 1. Please fix these on your branches and reply with the new exact hashes. Please don't force-push over a hash A has already started gating; push new commits on top instead.

Round-1 verdicts:
- B5-test-isolation: approved.
- B5-16: approved, pending A gates.
- B5-12b, B5-13, B5-15: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES. Required fixes below.
Full reviews are available if you want them; I can paste sections.

B5-test-isolation bab90835: APPROVED. A added fixup 4d9a3f17 on branch claude/b5-test-isolation-fixup. Your basename-only target dir still collides, because 10 worktrees here are all named "tessera". The fix appends an 8-char hash of the full checkout path, and the README now carries a cleanup note. A will swift-gate it and merge it. Follow-up for later (not blocking): set a temp app dir for the whole test bundle. Latent real-catalog paths are AppModel.rescan (:1005 and :1013), AppModel.reopen (:1166), ModelAcquisition.shared and PresetStore.standard.

B5-16-dither-ax 3cb74ddb: source APPROVED. The oracle is stronger, there are no AX overrides, KeyRouter/trace are byte-identical to d0191c41, and the runner commits are patch-identical. A will run swift-gate on 3cb74ddb itself, because main's surface.rs changed after your aec3738e measurement, and then the GUI checkpoint. Please fix HISTORY-KEYBOARD-HANDOFF.md: it cites pre-rebase hashes, and its "defaults delete/write" step is wrong under --app-dir (prefs live in <app-dir>/Preferences.plist). Policy note: History buttons are Tab-reachable with Keyboard Navigation OFF, while Dither and LUT follow the system setting. A will confirm this on screen; tell me if it's intentional.

B5-12b 43724d1b: must fix before merge.
1. The self-test aborts at step 396 but reports "0 failure(s)". TransformSelfTest.swift:602 `guard await began(.warp) else { return finish() }` records no failure. Make aborts count as failures, and investigate why Warp on a text layer doesn't start (possible regression). Steps 393 and 396–399 ran on main's B5-12 evidence but not on this head.
2. Typing "nan" into W/H crashes the app, because UInt32(Double.nan) traps. NaN also reaches Rotate and Bend. Reject non-finite input in TransformNumberField.parsed(), and add a test.

B5-13 4de8b0b7: must fix before merge (blocker).
- A cancelled Apply can still land in history. Smart-object Liquify and Content-Aware Move commit via set_adapter_smart_filter → set_nodes_checked, which renders with a never-set cancel flag under the document lock. The pixel path also has a gap between the last cancel check and the write.
- The app's .discarded handlers in DocumentLiquify.apply and DocumentContentAware.apply ignore a job that actually succeeded, so the engine holds a history node the panels never show. Mirror B5-09 DocumentRetouch, which undoes a discarded job that succeeded.
- The cancel test accepts either outcome and covers pixel layers only. Make it deterministic and cover smart objects.
- Should-fix: Content-Aware Move preview can show a cancelled preview (the cancel check happens before show_layer_preview, after the lock is released).
- Also: add HANDOFF.md. Commit 33453c3c doesn't compile alone.
- Perf notes (not blocking): Liquify open makes a ~320 MB full-resolution copy at 20 MP, and there's a cross-document Liquify job-lock stall.
- B5-13 conflicts with B5-16 and B5-18 (DocumentView.swift, SmartFilterRows.swift) and with B5-19 (the document.rs module block). A will merge it last. Rebase it after the others land.

B5-15 859bdf10: code OK. The WP is NOT accepted: main-thread spans are 35.9–58 ms against the <8 ms target, and the full filter self-test crashes with an AppKit layout exception.
- Should-fix: a Cancel after the last checkpoint writes the file but the UI shows "cancelled". Report "exported" in that case.
- HANDOFF.md is stale: it cites aec3738e/7378ac16, but the real code head is fa14c703 on c15dee24.
- A can merge the code as partial progress if you fix the label, with the acceptance gaps recorded as open.

Planned merge order: test-isolation → B5-16 → 12b (after fixes) → 15 → 17a → 17b → 19 → 18 → 13 (last, after the blocker fix and rebase). A regenerates bindings after each FFI-touching merge.

The B5-17a/17b/18/19 review is still running; results will come separately.
